title: "Wei System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& -y\\
\dot{y} &=& x+z\\
\dot{z} &=& axz+y^2-1
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.6$ and initial condition $(-3,-1,0)$.
